SELECT "Daily Flow FIT 600-01"
FROM (
  SELECT
    last("FIT-600-01 Total Flow In Kg") - first("FIT-600-01 Total Flow In Kg") AS "Daily Flow FIT 600-01"
  FROM "mqtt"
  WHERE $timeFilter
  GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(null)
)
WHERE "Daily Flow FIT 600-01" > 0

SELECT "Daily Flow FIT 600-02"
FROM (
  SELECT
    last("FIT-600-02 Total Flow In Kg") - first("FIT-600-02 Total Flow In Kg") AS "Daily Flow FIT 600-02"
  FROM "mqtt"
  WHERE $timeFilter
  GROUP BY time(1d, 18h30m) fill(null)
)
WHERE "Daily Flow FIT 600-02" > 0

SELECT
  last("FIT-600-01 Total Flow In Kg") - first("FIT-600-01 Total Flow In Kg")
    AS "FIT 600-01"
FROM "mqtt"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY time(1h) fill(null)

SELECT
  last("FIT-600-02 Total Flow In Kg") - first("FIT-600-02 Total Flow In Kg")
    AS "FIT 600-02"
FROM "mqtt"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY time(1h) fill(null)

SELECT
    mean("FIT-600-01 Current Flow In Kg/s") AS "FIT-600-01",
    mean("FIT-600-02 Current Flow In Kg/s") AS "FIT-600-02"
FROM "mqtt"
WHERE $timeFilter
GROUP BY time($__interval) fill(null)
